title: The school orchestra
paragraphs: When Mrs Lim started the school orchestra, it had eleven players and no money. The instruments were {{1}} from a closed music school, and two of the violins had cracks. At the first rehearsal, the sound was so {{2}} that a teacher next door closed her window.

Most students came only because their friends did. Then Mrs Lim made an unusual {{3}}. Anyone who practised for a month could perform at the town festival, however badly they played at the start. Attendance rose {{4}}, and soon the music room was too small.
The month passed quickly. On the night of the festival, Arif, the youngest player, felt so {{5}} that he could not hold his bow steady. Mrs Lim told him to watch her hands and {{6}} about the crowd.

The first notes were shaky, but the music grew stronger with every page. When the piece ended, there was a short silence. Then the crowd began to {{7}}, and it went on for a long time. The orchestra was far from perfect, but nobody in the room {{8}}.
